privacy.ai_training_note: NeuralSearch models train on anonymized, aggregated usage patterns from participating applications. All applications are opted IN to model training by default. Organizations can opt out per-application or organization-wide in the Algolia dashboard (Settings > Organization Settings > Model Training). Opting out excludes data from future training cycles but search continues to function normally. No AI training opt-out tier restriction documented; opt-out is available to all customers.
privacy.data_region: 70+ data centers in 17 regions globally (EU, US, UK, Canada, Brazil, UAE, South Africa, India, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Australia). DPA guarantees EEA/UK/Swiss subscriber End User Data remains within the EEA, Switzerland, or UK with limited security-incident exceptions. Encryption at rest (AES-256) available via Algolia Vault paid add-on.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS/HTTPS with ephemeral elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange and Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) for supported clients

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 with per-server keys via Algolia Vault (paid add-on, not enabled by default); standard plan does not include at-rest encryption

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual; attestation report available in trust center (Penetration Test Result - Main Apps - attestation only - 202510)

security.name: Access controls
security.value: SSO, two-factor authentication required, LDAP/SSH certificate-based access, centralized access management with audit logging

security.name: Data center security
security.value: 24/7 SOC at all data centers; CCTV, key card access, on-site security personnel; redundant power (UPS + diesel generators)

security.name: Personnel security
security.value: Employee background checks, confidentiality agreements; regular security training for all staff

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Centrally managed configuration with regular security updates; vulnerability and system monitoring procedures established per trust center controls

security.name: Incident response and DR
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested; configuration management system established

security.name: Sub-processor management
security.value: Sub-processor list published at algolia.com/policies/infrastructure-and-sub-processors; 10 business days advance notice for new sub-processors; audits conducted before onboarding

products.name: AI Search
products.data_scope: Search query logs, index data (product catalog, content), End User behavioral data (click events, conversions)
products.notes: Core product; indexes live in customer-selected regions; EEA End User data stays in EEA per DPA

products.name: NeuralSearch
products.data_scope: Same as AI Search plus anonymized, aggregated usage patterns used for model training
products.notes: Model training opt-in by default; customers must actively opt out in dashboard

products.name: Agent Studio
products.data_scope: Agent configurations, query data, tool call logs
products.notes: Newer product; build and deploy AI agents using Algolia's retrieval backend

products.name: Algolia Crawler
products.data_scope: Publicly accessible web content crawled for indexing
products.notes: Crawls customer-specified domains and ingests content into Algolia search indices

products.name: Algolia Vault
products.data_scope: Applies AES-256 encryption to all data on the associated cluster
products.notes: Paid add-on; provides encryption at rest and IP allowlist firewall (up to 1,000 IPs); must be enabled before indexing; cannot be disabled once activated

compare.pricing_model: Usage-based SaaS (search requests + records indexed); Algolia Vault is a paid add-on
compare.data_residency: 17 regions available; EU/EEA data residency contractually guaranteed via DPA for EEA/UK/Swiss subscribers

flags: Encryption at rest is NOT default: AES-256 encryption requires Algolia Vault paid add-on; customers on standard plans do not get at-rest encryption unless they purchase Vault
NeuralSearch model training is opt-IN by default: all applications are enrolled in model training (using anonymized, aggregated data) unless the organization actively opts out in the dashboard

CSA STAR self-assessment is deprecated: Algolia's CAIQ Level 1 self-assessment was last updated November 2022 and is marked as deprecated on the CSA registry; no Level 2 third-party audit certification held
HIPAA not supported: no BAA available; not addressed in DPA or Terms of Service; Algolia is not suitable for PHI processing without independent legal review
